statement: Ruchaka Yoga (Mars in its own or exaltation sign, in a kendra from the Ascendant) carries physical courage, leadership, and a pioneering, action-oriented drive — traditionally read as favoring fields that call for strength or decisive action.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
